input.prompt: Website hero: four friendly rounded software robots in white and periwinkle blue standing in a row on floating pale-blue platforms, each holding one item: the first holds a paper invoice with a green check mark, the second holds a stack of mixed documents with a magnifying glass, the third holds a shield with a small umbrella, the fourth holds a house with a key. Behind them a large dashboard screen with a bar chart and a progress bar, connected to the robots by thin dotted periwinkle lines. A smiling operations manager in a mustard-yellow sweater stands at the right pointing at the screen. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the sky, with a few flat pale clouds. Airy, balanced wide 16:9 composition, clean white space around the blob. Flat vector illustration in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the background blob, simple geometric characters and objects. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Pure white background outside one soft light-blue organic blob. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no currency symbols anywhere; documents and screens show only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
input.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, currency symbols, typography, logos, watermark, signature, ground line, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, heavy gradients, neon, orange magenta purple brand colors, clutter, extra limbs, distorted faces, blurry
